decision: Retain the four local hole-over-pad vias as epoxy-filled, planarized and copper-capped POFV. The TPS2552 redesign removes the former VBUS_CHARGER overlap and uses one VBUS_OVP POFV at U13.5 for the datasheet ILIM-to-IN 50..100mA configuration, so the total count and process class remain unchanged.
process: Via Resin Plugged + Via Plated Capped (epoxy-filled and copper-capped POFV)

findings: Minimum via pad diameter is drill diameter plus 0.15 mm.
Six-layer and higher boards automatically use resin plugging, plated capping and ENIG for via-in-pad.
Epoxy-filled and capped vias are described as flat and suitable for BGA and SMT holes.
Both double-sided openings and half-covered openings may be epoxy filled.
Plugging diameter must be identified in fabrication information.
Published leveled-pad quality permits depression up to 127 um and protrusion up to 50 um; assembly yield remains an EVT inspection item.

release_checks: Run check_via_in_pad_release_intent.py and exact-via-pad-overlap-audit.json before every manufacturing export.
Identify all 0.15 mm POFV holes in the fabrication manifest without relying on free-text communication.
Inspect cap planarity, solder voiding, opens and shorts on all five EVT boards, including X-ray where optical inspection cannot see the joint.
Do not treat published capability or DRC0 as physical assembly acceptance.
limitations: No manufacturing files have been uploaded and no vendor DFM result exists.
The published flatness range does not prove yield for these exact UFBGA and WSON/QFN joints.
